title: Реализовать hardened CI matrices и точное отображение P8 evidence tiers
summary: Превратить P1 compatibility contract и P8 workload tiers в least-privilege, bounded CI workflows с отдельными supported, lowest/latest и security lanes.
why: Один PHP 8.4 job не доказывает заявленную поддержку, а смешивание matrix-resolved locks с release inputs делает candidate неповторимым. `RAG:✅` Composer/Dart semantics в `@plan/knowledge/research-P9-design-rag.json`.

include: Hardened primary PR/push CI; extended scheduled/manual workflow; exact P8 `focused`/`bounded`/`extended` mapping; PHP supported runtimes plus fresh `--prefer-lowest --prefer-stable` and latest resolution; Dart supported runtimes plus fresh `pub downgrade` and latest resolution for both packages; generated drift, conformance, package/consumer, OSV and Gitleaks lanes; job timeouts, concurrency cancellation, cache-key isolation, artifact retention; Dependabot action/dependency update configuration where supported; machine-readable CI map.
exclude: Release-candidate bytes; SBOM/provenance/attestation; mutation of GitHub security settings; claiming unavailable dependency review/secret scanning; matrix-generated lock commits; public publication; universal timing thresholds.

rules: Exact runtime versions come from the executed P1 support contract, not duplicated literals without a generated equality check. Lowest/latest jobs run in fresh disposable copies, discard regenerated locks and can never supply P9.3 inputs. PR uses `focused` plus required bounded semantic/security gates; main uses `bounded`; scheduled/manual uses `extended`. `release-candidate` is not an alias for extended and belongs to P9.5. Timing blocks only on P8 matching fingerprints; mismatch stays explicit `baseline_pending`. OSV scans all three lockfiles with the pinned scanner. Gitleaks scans history and worktree with redacted output. An unavailable GitHub-native feature remains a visible capability gap, not an omitted/pass row.
guidance: Generate matrix rows from the support contract and validate exact set equality. Use separate caches per runtime/lock digest/trust plane; do not save a cache from untrusted fork code for a privileged consumer. Preserve raw child receipts and artifact digests. Keep the quick PR graph bounded and move full mutation/fuzz/storage/benchmark workloads to declared extended/release tiers without silently dropping critical P8 IDs.
deliverables: Hardened CI/extended workflows, dependency-update configuration, exact generated matrix/tier map and CI receipt inputs for P9.5.
